verdict.rationale: The API supports several compliance-adjacent filings (tax registration via ELSTER, trade registration, mandatory post-incorporation notifications) that could be driven end-to-end by an agent with webhook-based status polling, and a dedicated 'Compliance API' is mentioned. However, this Compliance API is gated to Enterprise plans with no documented endpoints, and there's no explicit evidence of 'annual report' preparation or filing as a discrete workflow. missing for 10: dedicated annual-report filing workflow, full Compliance API endpoint documentation (currently Enterprise-only and undocumented), evidence of agent-level orchestration across these APIs with minimal human input.
